title: cochlidium minus
intro: Cochlidium minus, commonly known as the dwarf cochlidium, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antipyretic, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The health benefits of Cochlidium minus include its ability to alleviate fever, relieve pain, and treat various infections due to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential health benefits.
